views.front: The full-size front view shows one continuous curved column from the bolted plinth to the shower head; the former section gaps are gone.
views.rear: The rear column has a continuous smooth bend and remains seated on its original base plate.
views.detail: The finish and original mixer and foot tap read clearly on the connected column; controls were preserved.
views.underside: The underside view retains the separate shower rose and base, with no visible breaks through the column.
views.clay: The neutral view confirms the original narrow shower proportions and a continuous crown. Its short upper bend remains intentionally compact.
